description: This file is a shell script used for testing the interaction between Git and SVN with respect to internationalization and commit encoding settings. It includes functions for comparing Git and SVN logs, setting up test repositories with different encodings, and verifying correct handling of commit encodings across different locales.

methods.name: compare_git_head_with
methods.description: Compares the current Git HEAD commit message with the contents of a specified file.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Prepares the environment for UTF-8 locale testing, likely setting locale variables.

methods.name: compare_svn_head_with
methods.description: Extracts and compares the SVN log message with a specified file, stripping out committers info.
